Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Prime Meat Stew by [[Cooking]] either [[Raw Prime Meat]] or a [[Raw Bird Thigh]] with [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Goat Butter]], or [[Fresh Milk]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Eating them will restore some of Link's [[Heart]]s. The savoriness of these [[Meal]]s comes from letting the [[Meat]] simmer. By adding a fifth [[Ingredient]], several different variations of Prime Meat Stew can be made: * '''Chilly Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Prime Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a chilly Ingredient. They grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Electro Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Prime Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an electric Ingredient. If eaten, they grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Prime Meat Stew}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an enduring Ingredient. These stews will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Prime Meat Stew}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an energizing Ingredient. Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] can be refilled partially by eating these stews. * '''Hasty Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Prime Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hasty Ingredient. Consuming them will increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Prime Meat Stew}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hearty Ingredient. When eaten, all of Link's Hearts will be healed and his maximum Hearts will be temporarily increased. * '''Mighty Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Prime Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a mighty Ingredient. Eating these will provide a boost to the power of Link's attacks. * '''Sneaky Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Prime Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a sneaky Ingredient. When these stews are eaten, they increase Link's [[Stealth]] abilities. * '''Spicy Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Prime Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a spicy Ingredient. By eating them, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Prime Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Prime Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Letting the large portions of choice cuts of meat simmer brought out their savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a tough Ingredient. Link will receive a boost to his [[Defense]] by eating these. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Meat Stew * Meal * Meat Stew }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Stews |items= BotW, TotK }}
